title: Claude — final pass on the 47 partial programme ratings
author: Claude (Opus 5.5)
scope: 47 partial evaluations at the baseline commit. Only missing axes and contractual contradictions were researched; axes already documented are carried over unchanged (axesCarriedFromBaseline) unless listed in revisedAssessments. Engine, catalogue, prices and Scale C untouched. ChatGPT handles the other 27 IDs and consolidates.
method: Five-axis rubric of chatgpt/programmes-batch4 (0 / 0.5 / 1 per axis, funded-stage rules only, no double penalty). Stars only when all five axes are sourced and the final status is "note complète". Official firm pages only; WebSearch and WebFetch on 28 Nov 2026.

statusValues.note complète: all five axes sourced; stars computed
statusValues.contradiction persistante: official sources disagree on an axis that changes the score
statusValues.offre arrêtée: official page says the offer is no longer sold
statusValues.information officielle indisponible: official rule missing, unreadable or catalogue ID not mappable

consistency.reason: Re-read on 28 Nov 2026 (same evidence set as audits/CLAUDE_PROGRAMME_BATCH_2026-11-28.json): the High Stakes page, general rules FAQ (3 Nov) and payout FAQ (24 Nov) list no consistency rule; the consistency FAQ (30 Oct) says the percentage depends on account type or region without naming programmes; an official blog (Sep 2026) states a 50% funded-only rule for High Stakes; the 2-Step Plan FAQ states 50% on the Pro account for a plan whose price and 3% daily loss do not match High Stakes. Not rated until The5ers names the rule for High Stakes.

programmes.notes: If the 50% funded-only rule is confirmed the axis would be 0.5 (total 3.0); if no rule applies it would be 1 (total 3.5).

drawdown.reason: Funded swing drawdown formula still not published: the programme terms define the stop-out as the account value by equity and describe a one-time move of the max drawdown to the initial balance at 3x daily-loss in equity, but give no swing-specific amount; the programme page gives 7% of buying power for the swing evaluation only and no funded swing terms.

Funded swing drawdown formula still not published: the programme terms define the stop-out as the account value by equity and describe a one-time move of the max drawdown to the initial balance at 3x daily-loss in equity, but give no swing-specific amount; the programme page gives 7% of buying power for the swing evaluation only and no funded swing terms.

Edge Pro: 4% maximum drawdown on 50K and 100K, calculated on end-of-day values; the page does not say whether it is fixed from the initial balance or trails EOD highs, nor whether it locks. Either 1 (EOD static) or 0.5 (EOD trailing) depending on the unstated formula; Edge is absent from the programme terms.

trading.reason: Day-trade only: positions must be flat by 4:50 PM ET daily and over the weekend (auto-close; open positions at close fail the account). News: the STEADY landing page advertises no blackout windows (evaluation section) while Article 3.3 (updated 20 Feb 2026) bars T1 news on all sim-funded accounts with liquidation; automation is "not supported" on the STEADY page but "allowed at FFN discretion" in the FAQ. Both readings give 0.5: session closure alone is material, and a T1 ban plus session closure is not severe under the rubric (same score as MFFU Pro).

programmes.notes: The news/automation wording conflict remains and should be clarified by FFN, but it does not change the axis score.
